bsp_partition_rule: each selected support-mesh root is replaced by its exact rational BSP; the root count upper multiplies the maximum bound over all BSP leaves
scope: all feasible positive-support profiles for the g=4 construction with one uniformly sampled global puncture lane
union_accounting: outward log2 sum over exact support-mesh root cells; BSP roots use their exact leaf maximum and the original verifier-recomputed root count upper
